# rigctld golden transcripts

Raw replies from Hamlib `rigctld` 4.6.2 (2025-02-09, SHA 870364, Debian
`libhamlib-utils` in `mercurychat-lab:rig`) running the dummy rig
(`-m 1`), to the extended (`+`) requests MercuryChat sends. Captured
18 Nov 2026 by a script that starts `rigctld -m 1 -P RIG` on loopback inside
the container; `get_ptt_on` was taken while a second client keyed the dummy
rig, and `get_ptt_rprt_11` from a rigctld started without `-P`. No hardware
and no RF were involved.
